findings.finding: v2 adds routine compactions (four on 2026-11-12 alone, §4:122; and the compaction point is H8's own setting) to the dated `changes[]` rule "units after a change are flagged; all post units flagged gives U3". A compaction dated in the post window before slot 289, or on 2026-11-13, therefore sends H-40 to H-44 (and at least flags most post days) to U3 by construction, whatever the data show.
findings.requiredChange: in §5:134 replace ", compactions" with ", a change to a compaction setting" and append to its handling "; routine compactions are not changes and flag no unit"; in §6:154 replace "compaction" with "compaction-setting change".

findings.finding: The RV1-16 closure cites a descriptive slip total that no section of v2 states.
findings.requiredChange: append to H-44 (§2:67) "The total of lost-detail slips over post slots is reported descriptively." and change the §14:264 location cell to "section 2 (H-44)".

findings.finding: The new "the first interval starts at the scope message" rule gives N intervals for N step reports when the scope message comes before the first report. The pinned 288 baseline is 25 reports, 24 intervals from 09:58, and it does not say that 09:58 is the scope message, so post slots may be measured with one more interval than the baseline behind 18.87.
findings.requiredChange: append to the 288 cell "(the 09:58 point is the scope message)" if the monitor confirms this; otherwise replace the clause with "the first interval starts at the first step report, as in 288's 24 intervals".

findings.finding: `fanOut3PlusStartUsage` holds one percent per window, but a window can hold several fan-outs, and the H-38 guard (§7:180) flips on which one is recorded.
findings.requiredChange: "(the highest percent at which a fan-out of 3 or more sessions started inside the window, or null)".

findings.finding: The new H-41/H-42 defect guards read H-40's pre slots 285-287, but section 3 sets no pre minimum for them. If those pre defects are missing, region 5 cannot be computed and SUPPORTED can be reached with the guard untested, which is the RV1-1 risk again.
